title: Yoga, Pilates & Mind-Body Cross-Feed Daily Correlation
dataSources: Down Dog sessions (`downdog:session`), Peloton yoga classes (`peloton:yoga`), Glo classes (`glo:class`), Pilates sessions (`pilates:session`), and mat usage logs (`mat:usage`).
app: Down Dog session logs, Peloton yoga classes, Glo streaming sessions, Pilates reformer notes, and home mat usage counters sent to Splunk HEC.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=mat:usage) OR (index=personal sourcetype=pilates:session))
| bin _time span=1d
| eval feed=case(sourcetype="mat:usage","primary",sourcetype="pilates:session)","secondary",1=1,"other")
| stats count as events by _time feed
| chart sum(events) over _time by feed
description: Lines up daily volume from mat:usage and pilates:session) to see whether two yoga, pilates feeds move together.
value: When two related exports diverge — one busy, one silent — it usually means a connector broke on only one path.
implementation: Forward both `mat:usage` and `pilates:session)` into `index=personal` and compare daily counts on one chart.
visualization: Dual-line chart of daily events per sourcetype.
grandmaExplanation: It shows whether your two main yoga, pilates data feeds rise and fall together or if one of them quietly stopped keeping up.
